      "body": "Links exported from Jira:\n\nis duplicated by [SYN-485](https://matrix.org/jira/browse/SYN-485)\nrelates to [SYAND-139](https://matrix.org/jira/browse/SYAND-139)\nrelates to [SYIOS-194](https://matrix.org/jira/browse/SYIOS-194)\nrelates to https://github.com/matrix-org/synapse/issues/1540\n"

    {
      "id": 258911218,
      "url": "https://github.com/matrix-org/synapse/issues/1360#issuecomment-258911218",
      "created_at": "2015-08-18T20:18:21Z",
      "updated_at": null,
      "author": "Participant 1",
      "body": "By @​matthew:matrix.org: this could be per room to avoid leaking msg contents unnecessarily to apple and google\n\n-- NEB (Bot)\n"
    },
    {
      "id": 258911220,
      "url": "https://github.com/matrix-org/synapse/issues/1360#issuecomment-258911220",
      "created_at": "2016-03-28T18:18:31Z",
      "updated_at": "2016-11-07T18:07:42Z",
      "author": "Participant 1",
      "body": "I tested this, and it works fine to just comment out https://github.com/matrix-org/synapse/blob/master/synapse/push/httppusher.py#L91-L92.\n\nThe IOS client at least then says \"$user posted in $channel\", so you lose the notification text, but if [SYIOS-194](https://matrix.org/jira/browse/SYIOS-194) and [SYAND-139](https://matrix.org/jira/browse/SYAND-139) are fixed, we should be able to just drop those lines with no loss of functionality, I think.\n\n-- Tollef Fog Heen\n"
    },
    {
      "id": 258911221,
      "url": "https://github.com/matrix-org/synapse/issues/1360#issuecomment-258911221",
      "created_at": "2016-05-05T10:33:56Z",
      "updated_at": "2016-11-07T18:07:42Z",
      "author": "Participant 1",
      "body": "This bug is a mess, as it conflates together two things:\n- A setting to let users say \"please don't show contents of notifications in the lockscreen of my phone\"\n- An architectural change to never send push notification bodies to APNS or GCM, and instead transfer the body out-of-band of the push.\n\nI've split out the latter into https://github.com/matrix-org/synapse/issues/1540\n\n-- @ara4n\n"
    },
    {
      "id": 287927268,
